Write song  in Eminem's style (lyrical spelling, flow notation, profanity, and authentic slang, expressions, and idioms.)
Theme: the main character blames himself for having screwed up hi; s life and regrets not becoming the person he wanted to be life and regrets not becoming the person he wanted to be;
He’s addicted to drugs (powder), alcohol,  probably to escape reality, since he sees no meaning in his life, but most of all he regrets that because of his own screw-ups  he lost the very girl who loved him with all her heart and  tried to keep him from going down the wrong path,
Mood: melancholic, intense, fatalistic, dark, desperate.

Flow, rhyme habits, rhythmic quirks:
Highly technical, tightly packed flow with extreme internal rhyme density. Frequent use of rapid multi-syllabic chains, cascading rhyme sequences, and phonetic stacking. Rhythmic delivery shifts between steady cadence and sudden acceleration, often cramming syllables into short bars. Enjambment is constant, with lines bleeding into each other to maintain rhyme continuity. Syncopation and off-beat phrasing are used to increase tension and unpredictability.
